convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iADXWilder indicator. Simple crossover entry with fixed SL/TP. Fixed lot sizing. No external libraries or custom indicators. Standard market order execution.
custom_logic_notes: Entry uses shifted bar values ([0+shift],[1+shift]) with configurable shift input (default=1), meaning signal is evaluated on previous completed bar by default. DI+ crossing above level_p triggers long; DI- crossing above level_m triggers short. No position allowed if any position (buy or sell) with same MAGIC already exists (ExtPos checks both sides). SL/TP are calculated as fixed offset from entry price using Point() — no 5-digit adjustment is applied, so on 5-digit brokers SL/TP would be 50 pips instead of 500 pips unless the user adjusts input values.
python_conversion_notes: Simple ADX crossover strategy. Use ta.trend.ADXIndicator from ta-lib or pandas-ta for ADX Wilder calculation. Note the shift parameter allows looking back N bars for signal generation (default shift=1 uses last completed bar). SL/TP are fixed pip offsets — need to multiply by Point equivalent (1e-5 for 5-digit forex, 1e-4 for 4-digit). The position gate (ExtPos) blocks ALL new entries when any position exists with matching magic number — implement as a simple no_position check. Watch the ADX buffer indices: buffer 1 = DI+, buffer 2 = DI-.
